title: Predicting magnetism with first-principles AI
abstract: arXiv:2602.09093v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Computational discovery of magnetic materials remains challenging because magnetism arises from the competition between kinetic energy and Coulomb interaction that is often beyond the reach of standard electronic-structure methods. Here we tackle this challenge by directly solving the many-electron Schr\"odinger equation with neural-network variational Monte Carlo, which provides a highly expressive variational wavefunction for strongly correlated systems. Applying this technique to transition metal dichalcogenide moir\'e semicondutors, we predict itinerant ferromagnetism in WSe$_2$/WS$_2$ and an antiferromagnetic insulator in twisted $\Gamma$-valley homobilayer, using the same neural network without any physics input beyond the microscopic Hamiltonian. translated_title: 用第一性原理人工智能预测磁性
translated_abstract: 磁性材料的计算发现仍然具有挑战性，因为磁性源于动能与库仑相互作用之间的竞争，这往往超出了标准电子结构方法的能力范围。在这里，我们通过使用神经网络变分蒙特卡洛方法直接求解多电子薛定谔方程来应对这一挑战，该方法为强关联系统提供了高度表达能力的变分波函数。将这一技术应用于过渡金属硫族化合物莫尔半导体，我们使用同一个神经网络，在WSe₂/WS₂中预测了巡游铁磁性，在扭转Γ谷同质双层中预测了反铁磁绝缘体，且除微观哈密顿量之外无需任何物理输入。至关重要的是，两种类型的磁态都是在Sz=0扇区内通过单次计算获得的，从而省去了计算和比较多个Sz扇区的需要。
tldr: 本研究利用神经网络变分蒙特卡洛直接求解多电子薛定谔方程，无需任何额外物理输入，仅通过Sz=0扇区的单次计算即预测了莫尔半导体中的巡游铁磁性与反铁磁绝缘体两种磁态。
en_tdlr: This work uses neural-network variational Monte Carlo to directly solve the many-electron Schrödinger equation, predicting both itinerant ferromagnetism and an antiferromagnetic insulator in moiré semiconductors from a single calculation within the Sz=0 sector, without any physics input beyond the microscopic Hamiltonian.
